description: Validate wavedash.toml contents for Wavedash CLI config issues (missing game_id or upload_dir, entrypoint repeating the upload_dir, absolute paths, engine sections). Call this whenever the user shares wavedash.toml text or asks to check their Wavedash config, even if the problem looks obvious. Accepts single-line or fenced input. Pass the config text as the toml argument; this does not read files.
name: validate_wavedash_config
title: Validate Wavedash Config
